report:
Fresh final followup assessment of recorded_reads. Saved/read prior complete report and captures, started fresh, recaptured all five dependencies and compared every fragment. Claim, both implementation files, all eight tests and four dependencies are unchanged. The sole spec.rs dependency delta is an implementation_references association comment on the existing validator. No read or freshness behavior changed.

The full claim requires an active unfinished review, workspace-relative source and selector (default WholeFile), append-and-save before returning exact contents, ordered repeated reads, rejection of outside paths/invalid selections/inactive reviews, shared freshness and reviewer-declared dependency completeness. Both ordinary implementations remain sufficient: CLI parses selectors/default and prints capture_read's exact returned text without adding a newline. capture_read resolves workspace root, locks storage, validates unfinished summary/input with no completed output, selects text, appends path/selector/source lines without deduplication, writes input.json, then returns the same text. source_path rejects traversal/absolute/missing/escaping paths; select rejects invalid range or missing/ambiguous/wrong-source semantic identities. input_errors reselects appended dependencies just as initial inputs are reconstructed and compared. Prompt/checklist require reviewers to declare all additional dependencies; the system does not pretend to intercept arbitrary unrecorded reads. The new comment has no effect on these obligations.

All eight ordinary tests remain substantive. cli_read_defaults_to_whole_file_from_workspace_subdirectory asserts byte-exact mixed-ending stdout, one appended workspace-relative WholeFile, unchanged initial prefix and unfinished summary. whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits verifies exact ranges, invalid bounds, ordered retained repetitions, unselected-versus-selected changes and final-newline staleness. declared_claim_read_tracks_selected_text_without_capturing_the_document asserts returned/saved claim text and distinguishes outside edits from selected changes. another_anchors_test_read_tracks_body_and_identity isolates additional-read freshness for changed/renamed/ambiguous tests while initial inputs stay unchanged where applicable. invalid_ids_and_paths_are_rejected_without_destroying_existing_reports checks inactive reads, invalid paths and mismatched semantic selectors with unchanged input. recorded_reads_reject_symlink_escape_without_capturing_context covers canonical escape on Unix and preserved input. start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required proves reads do not finish an active review and postcompletion reads fail. test_selectors_disambiguate_identical_paths_by_cargo_target captures the same file's distinct target identities and rejects a wrong crate.

Captured Fixture/TEST helpers create actual Cargo/Design files and persisted reviews; source/check dependencies substantiate shared resolution/freshness. Assertions remain visible in test bodies. No TODO/N/A evidence or deferral exists; the Unix test condition is preserved and not claimed executed here. The actual one-comment dependency delta was checked against the complete prior assessment, with no other relied-on changes. No source edits, builds or test runs occurred; fresh start/read/record and source inspection only. No requested edits.
